body: GREG DIRECT RULE (2026-10-22): only Sol or Opus may author changes to source code or tests. Architects do not write, modify, prepare, test, review for landing, or merge implementation patches; they may state an architectural decision or diagnose a blocker only. A Merger integrates already-delivered, authorized patches and does not implement them. Coordinators may route and record work, but must assign any code change exclusively to Sol or Opus. Source: Greg's direct message to Advisor: "Kazalem aby Tylko Sol albo Opus kodowal zmiany w kodzie." This clarifies and reinforces rules-architect-escalation-boundary; it applies immediately to current and future work in this project.
